loan_offers_amount_chk.name: loan_offers_amount_chk
loan_offers_amount_chk.value: amount_kobo > 0 and tenure_months > 0 and total_kobo = amount_kobo + interest_kobo

members_employee_no_live_uq.name: members_employee_no_live_uq
members_employee_no_live_uq.where: status in ('active', 'suspended') and employee_no is not null

members_exit_after_join_chk.name: members_exit_after_join_chk
members_exit_after_join_chk.value: date_exited is null or date_exited >= date_joined

savings_import_source_chk.name: savings_import_source_chk
savings_import_source_chk.value: (import_key is null) or (source = 'import' and batch_id is not null)
